Louisiana State University lost its latest bid for a retrial in sex-based pay bias and retaliation litigation brought by two female former in-house lawyers who claim the school rescinded their contracts after they sought raises. LSU failed to put forth any evidence that would create a different jury verdict in the case brought by the lawyers, but the $750,000 damages awarded to each plaintiff should be reduced, the US District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana said Wednesday.
